column1: # Transit & Flow - edge function verify_jwt baseline
# verify_jwt is a GATEWAY control, not a function control. When true, Supabase
# rejects a request with no Authorization header before the isolate runs. When
# false, the gateway is open and the FUNCTION must authenticate itself, which
# for a webhook means a provider signature and for an internal worker means a
# "false" is therefore not a weaker setting, it is a different one, and it is
# correct for every inbound webhook: Twilio, Quo, Housecall Pro, Meta, Slack,
# Stripe and Shopify do not send a Supabase JWT.
# Measured from production on 2026-08-16 with mcp list_edge_functions. This file
# is the recorded posture; scripts/verify_verify_jwt.py fails when the live
# platform drifts from it. Change a value here only in the same commit that
# deliberately changes the platform, and say why in the commit message.
#   gate = open   -> gateway does not check a JWT; the function authenticates itself
#   gate = jwt    -> gateway requires an Authorization header
